root_cause.text: The driver accesses the controller's private data (struct spi_imx_data) after calling spi_unregister_controller(), which frees the controller and its subsystem-allocated driver data, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a reference hold (spi_controller_get()) before spi_unregister_controller() and releases it (spi_controller_put()) after all driver cleanup operations, explicitly preventing the controller from being freed prematurely. The CVE and commit message state that the SPI subsystem frees the controller and driver data as part of deregistration unless device-managed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential use-after-free in SPI IMX driver removal by holding a reference to the controller before unregistering it.
intent_record.what: Added a call to spi_controller_get(controller) before spi_unregister_controller(controller) in the spi_imx_remove function.
intent_record.how: This increments the reference count of the SPI controller, preventing it from being freed prematurely during the unregister process and ensuring safe access to the controller structure in subsequent operations.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing spi_controller_put call to balance reference count in SPI IMX driver remove path, preventing a reference leak.
intent_record.what: Added a call to spi_controller_put(controller) in spi_imx_remove after spi_imx_sdma_exit(spi_imx).
intent_record.how: This decrements the reference count on the SPI controller device during driver removal, ensuring proper cleanup and preventing a reference leak.
